versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ppt-generator skill for automatic PPT creation.
- Supports generating PPTs from user-provided topics or outlines.
- Offers three workflow options: Tongyi Qianwen PPT, Kimi PPT, and local generation.
- Requires user to log in to Tongyi Qianwen for full functionality.
- Suitable for experience sharing, product introduction, and courseware scenarios.
- Informs users of download location for generated PPT files.
